_README: Walking that is not boundary. See scripts/off_boundary.py.
Keyed by survey unit. Each entry is a place, a radius in metres, and
why. Any recording lying wholly inside that circle is left out of the
boundary network for that one survey. Nothing is deleted, no raw file
is touched, the walking still appears on the map and still counts as
Added only after someone has looked at the map it changes.

Ginangi — Zone 7B.what: five recordings, 437 m, on the road junction by the Afore Market
why: A knot of short recordings 11 km from the rest of the survey's
line, sitting on a road junction. Three of the five are named only
by a timestamp; the other two are 'Stecan job mokondo ginagi clan /
Afore Market' and 'Joshua mokodo Ginage clan track recording'.
Somebody arriving somewhere and marking it. The closing step could
not tell that from an edge, reached out to it, and drew chords 1, 2
and 3 — 10.3 km — across the middle of the clan to get there.
Marked off the boundary by the reviewer on 2026-10-13.
